# Twiinn AI

> Twiinn AI is a SaaS marketplace where creators build an AI chatbot "twin" of themselves, trained on their content. Fans subscribe monthly to chat with the twin 24/7. Creators keep 85% of subscription revenue (Twiinn takes a flat 15% platform fee). Currently pre-launch — join the waitlist at https://twiinn.ai/#waitlist.

## What is Twiinn AI?

Twiinn AI lets content creators (fitness coaches, finance educators, beauty influencers, tech reviewers, etc.) create an AI-powered chatbot trained on their content — videos, posts, podcasts, and more. The AI twin answers in the creator's tone, with their advice and personality. Fans pay a monthly subscription to chat with it anytime. The creator approves the twin's personality before it goes live and stays in full control (set limits, block topics, review conversations).

## How it works

1. **Train** — Connect YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram, or upload content. Twiinn trains an AI that mirrors your style, expertise, and personality.
2. **Launch** — Set your own monthly subscription price (any amount you choose). Your twin goes live, available 24/7.
3. **Earn** — Fans subscribe to chat with your twin. You keep 85% of every subscription. Twiinn handles payments, hosting, and AI.

## Business model

- Creators set their own subscription price — any amount they want.
- Platform fee: a flat 15%. Creators keep 85% of every subscription and message credit.
- Founding offer: the first 50 creators pay 0% platform fees for their first 6 months.
- Earnings depend on audience size and price. The formula is: subscribers × monthly price × 85%. Example: 250 subscribers at $19.99/month is about $4,248/month to the creator. No guaranteed or average earnings are claimed.
- Fans get a set number of messages per month included in their subscription and can buy additional message credits.

## Key features

- AI trained on the creator's actual content and personality
- 24/7 availability — the twin never sleeps
- Full creator control — approve the personality, set limits, review conversations, block topics
- Real-time chat with streaming responses
- Creator dashboard with earnings, subscribers, and message analytics

## Industry context

- Creators are already cloning themselves: CarynAI (Caryn Marjorie) earned $71,610 in its first week (Fortune, 2023); Amouranth's AI earned $34,000 in its first 24 hours (Decrypt, 2023); Grimes invited fans to make AI songs with her voice for a 50% royalty split (Rolling Stone, 2023). Twiinn brings the same capability to any creator without custom tech or a team.
